title: Can We Trust AI Agents? A Case Study of an LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Ethical AI

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting a multi-agent LLM system with a real-world project scenario (Amazon recruiting tool) known for gender bias, then using thematic analysis and hierarchical clustering to evaluate if the generated code and discussions incorporate appropriate bias mitigation strategies.

Prompting a multi-agent LLM system with a real-world project scenario (Amazon recruiting tool) involving language bias, then using thematic analysis and hierarchical clustering to evaluate if the generated code and discussions incorporate appropriate bias mitigation strategies.

Prompting a multi-agent LLM system with real-world scenarios involving racial bias (deepfakes targeting Black celebrities and image classifiers mislabeling Black people), then using thematic analysis and hierarchical clustering to evaluate if the generated code and discussions incorporate appropriate bias mitigation strategies.
